versions.changelog:
- Added detailed methodology and executable workflow for reaching GOLD level (10000 points) in the WorldQuant BRAIN Challenge using AI assistance.
- Included practical scripts for registration, field/operator discovery, alpha factor construction, Sharpe/Fitness/self-correlation gate checks, and daily submission cycles.
- Clarified scoring rules, submission constraints, and optimal daily routines for challenge success.
- Provided bilingual support (English/中文) for users interested in alpha mining and challenge strategies.
- Emphasized a "teach-to-fish" philosophy: encourages users to iterate and customize their own workflows and research logs, rather than sharing static factor lists.
